buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 6. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 7. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): Government / NABL approved Lab . 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Commander 42 BRTF . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after

making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Commander 42 BRTF A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 10. Bidder financial standing Undertaking: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings should not be bankrupt. Bidders are advised to upload undertaking to t his effect alongwith bidding documents. 2. Past project Experience: Please upload past project work experience of same or similar product cat egory as per following:- a) Minimum 1 order of 80 % of Bid products: Copy of supply order shall invariably be uploaded alon gwith CRAC or work completion certificate with value of order. OR b) Minimum 2 orders of 40 % of Bid products: Copy of supply order shall invariably be uploaded alo ngwith CRAC or work completion certificate with value of order. 3. Bidders are advised to must be mention offered product Brand/Make/Product specification during t echnical bid. 4. OEM/Bidder annual turnover: - Please upload minimum Annual Turnover/Balance sheet of last three FY (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) duly signed by Charted Accountant. 5. OEM/OEM authorised dealers/distributers are only allowed to participate for this Bid. OEM authorise d dealers/distributers are advised to must upload valid authorisation certificates during technical bid. 6. Test results, with all relevant IS/IRC codes from certified NABL lab/Govt Lab should be submitted at the time of supply of material and also upload the same at the time of Tech Bid also. 7. Bidders are advised to upload undertaking certificate to ensure the offered product must be an ISI mark Brand. The specification of crash barrier will be as per IRC:119-2015/ All other relevant Codes. 8. Payment of the stores received will be done only after received product as per specification upload ed with bid and passing the quality check of the stores by the BOO detailed by HQ 42BRTF at consignee lo cation and after testing carried out by Consignee by NABL / Govt Lab after receiving of Stores. 9. Bidders are advised to upload the certificate for accepting the all the terms and conditions of the Bi d, before opening of Tech Bid. 10. Bidder undertakes and submit the certificate on 100 Rs. Stamp Paper duly quoted bid numbe r & date, that “presently the Bidder is not Debarred from Bidding or blacklisted by any depart ment till date" on the grounds mentioned in Rule 151 of GFR 2017. 11. Crash Barrier should confirm to above specification and design or any other design or a

ny other design duly approved by MORTH and satisfy the following conditions: - a) All material should be ISI marked confirming to IS 5986/2062/1074 and Grade Fe 410 b) Mass of Zinc coating for W- Beam, Post, Fish Tall, Terminal, Bolts and Nuts and washers, Sp acers - 550gm/M² c) Test report shall be submitted for ISI marked HR Coil and Zinc Coating from Govt/NABL/ILA C accredited lab to prove conformity the specifications both at the time of Technical bidding and w hile supply of Stores. d) Metal Safety Barriers Test as per IRC 119-2015 annexure II of Para 3 : All steel elements in cluding posts, W-Beam sections, channel sections, bolts, nuts, hardware and other steel fittings sh all be A/U Set galvanised or painted with an approved paint. If galvanised, all elements shall be fre e from abrasion, rough or sharp edges, and shall not be kinked, twisted or bent. Damaged galvanis ed surfaces, edges of holes and ends of steel sections cut after galvanising shall be cleaned and re -galvanised. The posts and W-Beam sections shall be assembled true to alignment and camber as shown in the drawings. The metal safety barriers shall be compliant with test acceptance criteria o f European EN 1317-2 standard or NCHRP 350 for containment levels of N2, H1 and H2 or NCHRP 3 50 for containment levels TL-3 and TL-4. The manufacturer shall provide all applicable crash test r eports that confirm the barrier to have passed the crash tests conducted by an international accre dited cash testing laboratory having all the needed testing facilities authenticated crash test repor t. 12. Past Performance of similar stores – 80% 13. Warranty period shall be mentioned in the T-Bid. 14. Physical EMD must be submitted at the time of technical bid opening. Only m anufacturers of bid product is exempt from submitting the EMD; subject to provide pr oof of Manufacturer by relevant documents and certificates by Bidders, for all others, submission of EMD is mandatory. 15. Mandatory Quality Undertaking: - Bidder must uploaded an underta king of Rs.100 (Non judicial stamp paper) confirming full compliance with I RC 119-2015 technical specifications & steel thickness tolerance. The undertaking acknowledges that failure in quality of material su pplied will result in immediate rejection ePBG will forfeiture & GeM blacklis ting without post rejection action. 16. Submission of ePBG within 14 days from the date of contract / Supply Order :- successful bidder must submit required ePBG (Performance security) 5% of contract value in favour of Commander 42 BRTF within 14 calendar days from date of issue of supply order. 17 Default & Cancellation: - Failure to submit ePBG within 14 calendar days shall be consider as a deliberate refusal / inability to enroot contract. In such event b uyer reserved the right of following:- · Cancel the SO/contract immediately without issuing further show cause notice. · Forfeit the entire EMD submitted with the bid. · Initiated a formal GeM incident under non submission of ePBG / failure to execute contract for vendor debarment / suspension across GeM port al.

18. Mandatory High Altitude Supply Capability undertaking:- Bidder / Selle r explicitly confirm that they have assessed geological, logistical and whether conditi on of supply location. The bidder warns outs that quoted rates are inclusion of all frei ght, transportation, transit Insurance, loading / unloading, and local handling charges to final consignee location site. No request for delivery extension or rate revision on a ccount of terrain challenges, hill transport difficulties, and weather disruption will be entertained under any circumstances. 19. Technical evaluation will be strictly conducted based on the mandatory documents uploaded at the time of bid submission. No post-bid submission of missing mandatory documents will be permitted under the guise of clarification. 2. 3. 4. Any representation raised by a bidder against technical disqualification must be backed by docume ntary proof referencing specific bid clauses. Frivolous, baseless, or abusive representations aimed at delaying the procurement process will be uploaded directly to the GeM Incident Portal under "Misc onduct / Disruption of Procurement Process" for administrative action across GeM. . 11. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.
